title: Citadel Conference Travel Grant 2026: Fully Funded Conference Travel Support for STEM Students
summary: Fully funded Citadel Conference Travel Grant for Ugandan STEM students to present their research at leading international conferences like NeurIPS 2026.
description:
International conferences are where STEM careers take off — but registration, flights and accommodation are usually out of reach for Ugandan students. The **Citadel Conference Travel Grant** removes that barrier for promising science and engineering students.

## What it is

The Citadel Conference Travel Grant is a fully funded opportunity that helps **STEM students** present their research at leading academic and industry conferences around the world. It is run by Citadel as part of its commitment to developing early-career quantitative talent.

## What the grant covers

- Conference registration or a full-access pass
- Round-trip airfare
- Accommodation for the conference dates
- Airport transportation
- A food stipend
- Invitations to Citadel-hosted dinners and recruitment events

## Who can apply

- Students in **mathematics, computer science, physics, statistics, electrical engineering and other quantitative disciplines**
- Applicants with a paper or poster accepted for presentation at an **eligible conference** (for example NeurIPS 2026 or the Grace Hopper Celebration 2026)
- **In-person presenters** — remote or purely virtual presentations are not eligible

## Why it matters for Ugandans

For Ugandan students, this grant is a rare shot at the global research stage. Presenting at a major conference lets you meet potential PhD supervisors, connect with industry mentors and put your university on the international map — without asking your family to fund international travel.

## How to apply

Choose an eligible conference, confirm your accepted presentation, then apply through the official Citadel programme for that conference before its own deadline (the NeurIPS 2026 deadline is 5 October 2026).

## Rate Musawo tip

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and funding is limited — apply the same week your paper is accepted. See the [official listing](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/08/11/citadel-conference-travel-grant-2026-fully-funded-conference-travel-support-for-stem-students/) for the full list of eligible conferences and their individual deadlines.
how_to_apply: Open the official [listing](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/08/11/citadel-conference-travel-grant-2026-fully-funded-conference-travel-support-for-stem-students/) to read the full eligibility criteria and submit your application (the NeurIPS 2026 deadline is 5 October 2026).

title: Global Model FAO 2026 Registration Opens: Join Future Leaders at the FAO Headquarters in Rome
summary: Register to represent a country and negotiate food-security policy at the Global Model FAO 2026 conference, hosted at FAO Headquarters in Rome.
description:
Have you ever wanted to sit at the negotiating table of a United Nations agency? **Global Model FAO 2026** lets you do exactly that — at the real headquarters of the Food and Agriculture Organization in Rome.

## What it is

Global Model FAO is a Model United Nations-style conference where students, educators, aspiring diplomats and young changemakers from around the world represent countries, debate pressing global issues and negotiate policies on food security, agriculture and sustainable development.

## Key details

- **Location:** FAO Headquarters, Rome, Italy
- **Open to:** students and young professionals worldwide — including Ugandans
- **Registration deadline:** 11 October 2026
- **Format:** immersive negotiation simulation, committees and networking with delegates from many countries

## Who can apply

Any motivated student or young professional interested in international relations, agriculture, food systems, development policy or diplomacy.

## Why it matters for Ugandans

Agriculture employs most Ugandans, yet Ugandan voices are rarely heard in global food-policy debates. Attending Model FAO gives you practical experience in international negotiation and a strong line on your CV for UN internships and graduate programmes in development.

## How to apply

Register through the official FAO Model conference page. Spaces are limited and processed on a first-come, first-served basis.

## Rate Musawo tip

Research your assigned country and its food-security position before you travel — the best delegates are the best prepared. See the [official listing](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/08/06/global-model-fao-2026-registration-opens-join-future-leaders-at-the-fao-headquarters-in-rome/) for registration details and fees.
how_to_apply: Open the official [listing](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/08/06/global-model-fao-2026-registration-opens-join-future-leaders-at-the-fao-headquarters-in-rome/) to read the full eligibility criteria and submit your application (registration closes 11 October 2026).

title: Science for Africa Foundation Event Scholarships 2027: Apply for Funding to Attend the Global Mental Health in Africa Conference (GMHAC2027)
summary: Science for Africa Foundation Event Scholarships fund Ugandan mental-health researchers, students and advocates to attend GMHAC2027 in Africa.
description:
Mental health is one of Africa's most under-funded health challenges — and the people who understand it best are often the ones who can least afford to attend the conferences where decisions are made. The **Science for Africa Foundation Event Scholarships** change that.

## What it is

The Science for Africa Foundation, with the Mental Health Innovation Network, is funding a limited number of **Event Scholarships** for the **Global Mental Health in Africa Conference 2027 (GMHAC2027)** — one of the continent's leading gatherings on mental health research, policy and services.

## What the scholarship covers

- Attendance at GMHAC2027
- Support for researchers, students, practitioners, advocates and people with lived experience who face financial barriers to participation

## Who can apply

Anyone working or studying in African mental health — researchers, clinicians, students, community advocates and lived-experience voices — who needs financial support to attend.

## Why it matters for Ugandans

Uganda has a severe shortage of mental health professionals, and Ugandan researchers and advocates are under-represented at continental conferences. This scholarship is a direct route for Ugandans to present their work, learn from peers across Africa and influence how mental health is prioritised on the continent.

## How to apply

Applications are accepted on a rolling basis through the Science for Africa Foundation — apply early to secure a place.

## Rate Musawo tip

Prepare a clear statement of how attending will strengthen your work — scholarships like this prioritise applicants with a concrete plan to use what they learn. See the [official listing](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/08/06/science-for-africa-foundation-event-scholarships-2027-apply-for-funding-to-attend-the-global-mental-health-in-africa-conference-gmhac2027/) for the application form.
how_to_apply: Open the official [listing](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/08/06/science-for-africa-foundation-event-scholarships-2027-apply-for-funding-to-attend-the-global-mental-health-in-africa-conference-gmhac2027/) to read the full eligibility criteria and submit your application.

title: One Young World Leading Scholarship 2026 in South Africa (Fully Funded)
summary: Fully funded One Young World Leading Scholarship 2026 — attend the OYW Summit in Cape Town, South Africa (3–6 Nov 2026) as a young Ugandan leader, aged 18–35.
description:
The **One Young World Summit 2026** brings together more than 2,000 young leaders from over 190 countries — and the **Leading Scholarship** makes sure exceptional young people from underrepresented countries, including Uganda, get there fully funded.

## What it is

One Young World is the world's flagship forum for young leaders. The Leading Scholarship covers the costs of attending the 2026 Summit, which takes place in **Cape Town, South Africa, from 3–6 November 2026**.

## Key details

- **Location:** Cape Town, South Africa
- **Summit dates:** 3–6 November 2026
- **Funding:** fully funded
- **Eligibility:** young leaders aged **18–35**, open worldwide with priority to applicants from underrepresented countries
- **Application deadline:** 31 October 2026 (rolling review)

## Who can apply

Young Ugandans already creating positive change in their communities or country — through social enterprise, health, education, advocacy or public service.

## Why it matters for Ugandans

This is one of the most accessible fully funded global leadership programmes for young Ugandans. Delegates return home with a global network, mentorship and the credibility to scale their projects — and applying is free.

## How to apply

Submit the online application and, for the Leading Scholarship, demonstrate the impact of your work and how you will bring the summit's ideas back to Uganda.

## Rate Musawo tip

Tailor your application to a specific problem you have solved in your community — concrete, measurable impact beats generic ambition. See the [official listing](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/06/14/leading-scholarship-2025-attend-the-one-young-world-summit-in-munich-and-unlock-exclusive-opportunities/) for the application link and full criteria.
how_to_apply: Open the official [listing](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/06/14/leading-scholarship-2025-attend-the-one-young-world-summit-in-munich-and-unlock-exclusive-opportunities/) to read the full eligibility criteria and submit your application (deadline 31 October 2026).

title: Rockefeller Foundation Bellagio Center Convening Program 2027: Fully Supported Global Convenings for Changemakers Tackling the World’s Biggest Challenges
summary: Rockefeller Foundation Bellagio Center Convening Program 2027 — apply for a fully supported one-week convening in Italy on health, food, climate or development.
description:
For more than six decades, the **Rockefeller Foundation Bellagio Center** in Italy has hosted the conversations that shape global policy. Its **2027 Convening Program** is now open to organisations — including African ones — that want to gather changemakers around a pressing global challenge.

## What it is

The Bellagio Center Convening Program funds and hosts high-impact, one-week convenings at its lakeside campus in Bellagio, Italy. Organisations bring together leaders, researchers, policymakers and innovators to work intensively on health, food systems, energy, climate, finance or international development.

## Key details

- **Location:** Bellagio, Italy (fully supported convening)
- **Who it is for:** organisations, institutions and partnerships proposing a convening
- **Deadline:** rolling (applications reviewed continuously)

## Who can apply

Universities, NGOs, research networks and coalitions — including Ugandan and East African institutions — that can convene the right people to advance a concrete agenda.

## Why it matters for Ugandans

Ugandan universities, NGOs and research networks rarely get this kind of supported, distraction-free convening space. A Bellagio convening can elevate an East African research agenda onto a genuinely global stage, with Rockefeller covering the hosting.

## How to apply

Organisations submit a convening proposal through the Rockefeller Foundation's official portal, outlining the challenge, the participants and the expected outcomes.

## Rate Musawo tip

Convenings are judged on the strength of the question and the calibre of participants — build a compelling agenda with named senior partners before you apply. See the [official listing](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/06/09/apply-now-2026-rockefeller-foundation-bellagio-center-convening-program-for-global-changemakers/) for the proposal form and guidance.
how_to_apply: Open the official [listing](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/06/09/apply-now-2026-rockefeller-foundation-bellagio-center-convening-program-for-global-changemakers/) to read the full eligibility criteria and submit your application.

title: The Economic, Social and Cultural Council Registration 2026–2027: How African Civil Society Organizations Can Gain African Union Recognition and Participate in Continental Policy Dialogue
summary: Register your Ugandan organisation on the AU's ECOSOCC Connect platform (2026–27) to gain African Union recognition and join continental policy dialogue.
description:
The African Union doesn't just belong to governments — it belongs to civil society too. Through **ECOSOCC**, African organisations can register, gain AU accreditation and help shape continental policy.

## What it is

The AU's Economic, Social and Cultural Council (ECOSOCC) has opened registration on its **ECOSOCC Connect** platform for civil society and diaspora organisations across Africa. Once registered, organisations can seek accreditation and participate in AU consultations and continental policy dialogue.

## Key details

- **Who it is for:** African civil society organisations and diaspora organisations
- **What you get:** an official AU platform profile, an accreditation pathway, and participation in continental consultations
- **Registration window:** open now through 29 October 2027

## Why it matters for Ugandans

Ugandan NGOs, health advocacy groups and youth organisations often work in isolation from continental policy. ECOSOCC Connect is the official doorway for Ugandan civil society to influence AU decisions on health, education and governance — and to build a continent-wide network of allies.

## How to apply

Register your organisation on the ECOSOCC Connect platform, complete the verification steps and apply for accreditation through the African Union.

## Rate Musawo tip

Registration is organisational, not individual — have your organisation's registration documents and leadership details ready before you start. See the [official listing](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/05/22/the-economic-social-and-cultural-council-registration-2026-2027-how-african-civil-society-organizations-can-gain-african-union-recognition-and-participate-in-continental-policy-dialogue/) for the platform link and step-by-step guide.
how_to_apply: Open the official [listing](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/05/22/the-economic-social-and-cultural-council-registration-2026-2027-how-african-civil-society-organizations-can-gain-african-union-recognition-and-participate-in-continental-policy-dialogue/) to read the full eligibility criteria and submit your application (open until 29 October 2027).

title: World Diplomacy Forum Bali 2026: Fully Immersive Leadership Experience with 100+ Scholarships for Global Youth Leaders
summary: World Diplomacy Forum Bali 2026 (7–9 Aug 2026) — three-day immersive diplomacy simulation with 100+ scholarships for global youth leaders. 2026 edition concluded.
description:
The **World Diplomacy Forum Bali 2026** was a three-day, action-driven leadership experience that went far beyond a traditional conference — placing young leaders in real-time simulations of diplomacy, crisis management and negotiation in Bali, Indonesia.

## What it is

Organised by the International School of Leadership and Diplomacy (ISLD), the forum used immersive simulations and performance-based recognition to train emerging leaders, diplomats and changemakers.

## Key details

- **Location:** Bali, Indonesia
- **Format:** three-day immersive forum with 100+ scholarships for global youth leaders
- **Event dates:** 7–9 August 2026 (now concluded)
- **Status:** the 2026 edition has finished — this listing is kept for reference and will be updated when the next edition's dates are announced

## Why it matters for Ugandans

Diplomacy and negotiation skills are exactly what Ugandan youth leaders need to advocate for their communities — and the forum's scholarship model makes international attendance possible for delegates from across Africa.

## How to apply

Watch the official World Diplomacy Forum channels for the next application cycle. Follow the [official listing](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/04/17/world-diplomacy-forum-bali-2026-fully-immersive-leadership-experience-with-100-scholarships-for-global-youth-leaders/) for updates on the next edition.

title: VV Visionaries Program 2026: Fully Virtual Global Leadership Program for Women Social Impact Leaders
summary: VV Visionaries Program 2026 — a fully virtual, global leadership programme for women social-impact leaders, from Vital Voices and the Estée Lauder Emerging Leaders Fund.
description:
The **VV Visionaries Program 2026** is a fully virtual, global leadership programme for women who are driving social impact — delivered by **Vital Voices** in partnership with the **Estée Lauder Emerging Leaders Fund**.

## What it is

A virtual leadership development experience for emerging women leaders across sectors — social enterprise, health, education and community organising — who want to grow their impact. The programme combines structured training, mentorship and peer networks.

## Key details

- **Format:** fully virtual — open to women anywhere, including Uganda
- **Partners:** Vital Voices Global Partnership × Estée Lauder Emerging Leaders Fund
- **Deadline:** rolling (apply early)

## Who can apply

Women social-impact leaders at the early stages of their journey who are already creating change in their communities and want the skills, network and confidence to scale it.

## Why it matters for Ugandans

Ugandan women leaders rarely get structured, globally recognised leadership training without leaving home. Because it is virtual, the programme is genuinely accessible to women across Uganda — no visa, no travel cost, just commitment.

## How to apply

Complete the online application through Vital Voices, sharing your leadership journey and the impact you want to create.

## Rate Musawo tip

Be specific about the community change you have already delivered — selectors look for demonstrated impact, not just ambition. See the [official listing](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/02/24/empowering-women-leaders-apply-for-the-vv-visionaries-program-2025/) for the application form.
how_to_apply: Open the official [listing](https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/2026/02/24/empowering-women-leaders-apply-for-the-vv-visionaries-program-2025/) to read the full eligibility criteria and submit your application.
